topics.title: The branch that is the whole point

tokens.v: Two orders for the same item can take completely different routes, and the difference is decided before anything is created.
If on-hand plus on-order already covers the demand, order planning generates nothing and the sales order goes straight to picking and shipping —
If it does not, MRP proposes, the transfer makes those proposals real, and Procurement and Manufacturing supply what is missing.

blocks.text: Two orders for the same item can take completely different routes, and the difference is decided before anything is created. If on-hand plus on-order already covers the demand, order planning generates nothing and the sales order goes straight to picking and shipping — stages 3 and 4 never happen. If it does not, MRP proposes, the transfer makes those proposals real, and Procurement and Manufacturing supply what is missing.

tokens.v: That branch is the edge marked `SKIPS 3, 4` in section 5
, and it is domain rather than drawing: which stages a route bypasses is a fact about Infor LN, and where the line is drawn on the page is not.
